records.subject: Welcome to Wrenfield, Granite Works!
records.body:
Hi Felix,

Welcome! Wrenfield works best once there's a real project in it, so that's the one thing I'd suggest doing first. Inviting your team comes next -- tasks are a lot more useful once more than one person is on them.

Reply any time.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

decisions.rationale: 6 days in with no project, no invite, no tickets and no reply to the welcome email [email:62fe0284]; all three stall reasons active. Starter, single admin, no engagement signal at all, with only 8 days left, so unaided activation is unlikely.

draft.subject: Getting your first project into Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Felix,

Checking in after your welcome note last week. Nothing's started in Wrenfield yet, so I wanted to make it easy: projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, and the in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project. Once that's in, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through your first project with you and answer anything as we go. If it's simpler, just reply here and I'll help over email.

Best,
Nadia
